sv.title: Högerradikala Vox: På tröskeln till historisk framgång
sv.summary: Om prognoserna stämmer så kommer högerpopulistiska Vox att få lika många mandat i söndagens spanska val – 62 av kongressens 350 – som svenska Sverigedemokraterna (SD) fick i septembervalet. Men partierna, som har mycket gemensamt, kom till på mycket olika sätt.

en.title: Far-right Vox: On the threshold of historic success
en.summary: If the forecasts are right, the right-wing populist Vox will win as many seats in Sunday's Spanish election – 62 of the Congress's 350 – as the Sweden Democrats (SD) won in the September election. But the parties, which have a lot in common, came about in very different ways.
